name: mirage
text: Sorry for the wait. (1) Your screenshot: it was taken before the key landed. The engine now reports 'Novig read-only key active: 16 reads a second, websocket on', so the new key works and the slow public route is gone. (2) Streaming: that is the websocket, and it is on again with that key. A scan reads about 10,000 Novig prices in ~2 minutes. (3) Bids: I set up to 20 bids per game and the bid wallet to 2000%. Bids up at once were already unlimited. The dollar caps are unchanged: $25 per game for bids and bets together, $3 max per bid. Twenty bids on a game will usually hit the $25 cap before the count, so tell me if you want that cap raised too.
